text:
anya: Quick intake — Zephyr-3B quant onboarding. Perf prelims look promising but codebench flagged a small hallucination uptick vs our Raven baseline. Need to decide canary plan (hosted + dedicated + private), fallback mapping, and gating metrics. Sharing quick checklist and numbers below.

cheng: Paste of the perf/eval snapshot from the earlier run:
```
model           qtype   p50_ms  p95_ms  tps   halluc_rate
zephyr3b        int8    48      95      1200  3.2%
raven-13b       fp16    62      140     900   1.1%
note: zephyr int8 yields ~1.5x throughput vs raven at ~similar p50 but higher halluc score on codebench (QA/code tasks).
```

ops-bot: CI run uploaded: https://ci.internal/runs/6789 — includes eval artifacts, raw logs, and per-prompt diffs.

mike: On infra — we have capacity in hosted pool for a small canary (5%) today; dedicated needs a reservation but we can spin a small reserved slice for internal traffic. For private customers, recommend a staggered invite-only canary since per-tenant infra differs.

anya: Proposed rollout plan (short):
- Stage 0 (internal): run zephyr3b-int8 in dedicated test pool for 6h against synthetic load + eval harness.
- Stage 1 (hosted canary): 5% traffic for 24h, route segments by customer_tier (non-SLA, dev orgs).
- Stage 2 (hosted ramp): 20% -> 50% over 48h if gates pass.
- Stage 3 (dedicated/private): opt-in beta for selected customers with toggle and explicit consent.

olivia: Gate metrics to watch (suggested):
- latency: p95 <= 200ms (absolute)
- cost: tokens/sec vs raven baseline (expect <= 0.9x per-token cost)
- quality: halluc_rate <= baseline + 0.5pp (so <= 1.6% here) measured on production prompt set + codebench
- semantic similarity / ROUGE/EM targets for regen-sensitive tasks
- regression alert if failure rate increases >0.3pp on high-importance prompts

mike: Canary routing snippet (example):
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 24h
  route_by: customer_bucket
  fallback_model: raven-13b
  metrics:
    - name: halluc_rate
      threshold: 1.6%
    - name: latency_p95_ms
      threshold: 200
```

cheng: Follow-ups I need: full eval sweep vs our prompt suites (conversational, code, summarization), runoff with different quant configs (int8, int4-fp8 hybrid), and a quick diff of tokenization behavior. I can run a 12h sweep overnight if infra is ready.

anya: Decisions for today: start Stage 0 now (dedicated test pool) and Stage 1 hosted 5% canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. @mike please provision the test slice and wire the fallback route. @cheng please run the overnight eval with int8 + int4 hybrid and post the artifacts to the CI link.

mike: Ack — provisioning now, will post details when ready.

ops-bot: Canary config created: https://infra.internal/canaries/zephyr3b-1782004567 (automated rollback hook enabled).

olivia: Added an eval job to compare hallucination diffs and per-prompt deltas; will flag any >0.5pp deltas.

anya: Cool — we'll reconvene after the Stage 0 run. If the overnight sweep reduces halluc_rate under 1.6% we proceed with hosted 5% tomorrow. If not, hold and iterate on quant config. :thumbsup:

cheng: Got it — starting sweep now.

mike: ETA for infra slice ~45m.

anya: Thanks team.
